Hi Emily — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the context and the spec sheet. Short answer: yes, we can put together a cohort promo. To move quickly, here's a starting proposal we use for similar programs:

- Promo credits: 10,000 free credits per cohort (shared pool) to cover prototyping spikes
- Discount: 20% off usage for first 6 months after onboarding (applies to hosted API)
- Onboarding: 2-hour onboarding + technical office hours for 8 weeks
- Terms: standard startup terms (DocuSign link), require a short MOU and a PO only if billing exceeds credits

I've attached a draft mutual action plan and a suggested termsheet. If SeedForge needs more bankable credit (e.g., 25k), I can escalate internally — need approval from growth and ops because that changes the cost exposure.

Would you be available Wed 1/14 for a 30-min call to align on usage profiles?

Karthik — thanks for the quick turn. Couple of follow-ups after internal review:

- 10k shared credits is helpful but likely to run out for a handful of teams (our 2025 cohort burned through credits quickly). Can you consider a one-time 25k cohort credit allocation?
- Alternatively, would Redwood accept a tranche structure: 10k up front, additional 15k on milestone (demo day) to be unlocked? That helps us keep teams honest and stretches the pool.
- On discount: 20% is good, but if we can get 25% for the first 3 months that'd be a big incentive for teams to choose Redwood.

We prefer minimal paper and a single DocuSign can work. SeedForge will provide a short PO if needed.

Best,
Emily

Thanks for the context. Agree SeedForge looks like a reasonable partner given their enterprise funnel. Approve the tranche structure with these guardrails:

- Credits: 10,000 allocated up front, additional 15,000 released on receipt of short post-demo usage report (submit within 7 days of demo day) — total 25,000 cohort credits
- Discount: 25% off hosted API for first 3 months (instead of 20%/6mo) — marketing-friendly and limits exposure
- Activation: 2-hour onboarding + 8 weeks office hours as proposed
- Contract: one DocuSign with the Redwood startup terms; require SeedForge to provide PO if billing beyond credits is expected.
- Metrics: require a one-page summary after cohort with top 3 signal wins (customer intros, enterprise leads, or product milestones) — we use this to evaluate promo ROI

I'll mark this as an approved promo exception. Please update the termsheet to include the tranche unlock condition and the deliverable (post-demo usage report + 1-page summary) and push the DocuSign. Assign deal id SF-2026-019 and create an opportunity in HubSpot.
